There is no map on this page. Naming the four largest fixed that and created this defect: 'Adjacent counties, Columbiana, Tuscarawas, Ashland, Carroll, 57,302' beside four counties that come to 36,913 reads as though those four ARE the bucket. The number was right and the words were not, and a reader added them and lost 20,389 jobs. The second sub-line now prints the subset arithmetic, so this claim bounds both failures: the names must be there AND they must not equal the bar.
